messages:
pat: quick flag  found a case where projectless org keys create noise in quota dashboards. console shows only org bucket.
indra: example?
pat: customer trace id c-9922: Authorization: Bearer sk_org_abc, X-Consent: consent=71. exchange returned 204, no project.
mika: expected exchange to attach a project if consent ties to one. looks like consent middleware exits early.
indra: options: 1) exchange synthesizes project id and marks telemetry synthetic=true 2) exchange returns X-Assigned-Project header for downstream to adopt 3) leave as org and update quota aggregator to consult consent mapping.
pat: leaning header for minimal blast radius. add auth.log fields original_token_type and consent_id.
mika: header approach fine, but billing will need mapping. include auth.synthetic_flag metric.
indra: i'll draft a small RFC and feature-flag (auth.assign_project_mode=header|synthetic|none). canary on one org.
pat: tests: unit for header emission, e2e to ensure quota agg consumes header.
ops-bot: queued deploy: canary ref=pr/3301 flags: auth.assign_project_mode=header
indra: will post RFC link shortly.
pat: thanks, keeping this thread for rollout notes.
